newsitem.title: USA: Abraxas meets all terms of CVR agreement.
newsitem.headline: Abraxas meets all terms of CVR agreement.

text.p: Abraxas Petroleum Corp said Monday that it has met the terms of its contingent value rights (CVR) agreement, which will retire the rights and result in no additional issuance of common shares.
The company said that income for the fourth quarter of 1996, fiscal year 1996 and the first quarter of 1997 were all diluted by potential CVR share issuance.
Earnings per share for the affected periods were reduced by $0.05, $0.03 and $0.02 respectively, but future reporting periods will not be affected.
Abraxas is a crude oil and natural gas exploration and production company that also processes natural gas.
